Under the owner's delegated blocker-decision authority, select GPT architecture revision03 for #486, with A1/A2 below. Actual Claude Fable5.2 xhigh independently returned ACCEPT REVISED PLAN, genuine exit0, report SHA-256 8a1c4fb12687d395daedfa59a099fe1779e93b6c675b2239cc0f6f035fc5243f. Original Fable01 REVISE PLAN and quota-ended02 remain unchanged. This is a coordinator selection, not a human plan-approved label or owner QA sign-off. Publish the written plan, full critique and this decision; remove only the delegated plan hold while retaining aidlc-ready and all technical gates. Owner review/rework of this decision occurs before owner QA as requested.

Selected architecture: the frozen i4-486-architecture-03 five-document packet and its26-boundary matrix, SHA256SUMS1785227456c24297a90e68f96c18156e583f797d066c5363d5a8f3a3ce52728c, with source02351e2fb932b3be44e7cc3fb3943a61d568226c. Use invocation-local concrete evaluation facts and static eligible data-only sites; fixed location/cause/action, indexed map/item locations, existing typed codes/nonresumability. Do not publish literal $error arguments, runtime strings, source, raw code/positions or arbitrary details. Preserve legacy evaluator value/error identity/wrapping, Mutate/Exit contracts, all provider/external exception policies, cancellation/termination/uncertainty precedence, prior inference provenance/retry fold, actual child links/completion, storage/history and WorkspacePort ownership. No dependency/schema/format/migration/UI change. R1-R6 and S1-S6 remain selected, including narrow after-result source-owned cause copy and existing file-return receipt catch.

A1 selected verbatim clarification: Compile and unsafe-regex reasons attach only to the top-level compile(expression) of the invocation's own pinned source. The same checks reached through CHECKED_EVAL fail a run-time string inside the evaluator call and yield only the neutral evaluation-rejected fact. Add explicit tests for malformed and unsafe-regex $eval strings. Do not attribute their syntax to the successfully parsed authored field. Direct engine compile/unsafe-regex negative cases may bypass publish validation and must be labeled synthetic reachability.

A2 selected: At the newly typed JSONata sites the evaluator's own message is neither published nor logged, as at B20. Confirm removal of that old internal-fallback private record at those sites; update the affected docs05 diagnostic row and ADR0088. Fixed safe field/cause/action remains public. Existing harness/provider text, historical rows, P01/P02/B20/B25 and unrelated private diagnostics retain their contracts. Other new local diagnostics follow the selected bounded correlation policy. This is a scoped logging change, not a claim that all existing logs omit raw text.

Why and alternatives: the40-case planning probe showed error class/code/details cannot establish origin, and callable/getter/array preprocessing paths make permissive literal extraction misleading. Fixed causes and a concrete per-invocation observer provide useful field-level guidance without exposing runtime arguments or requiring a new public AST/runtime scan. Decline guarded-literal publication, global/class-based provenance markers, arbitrary callback observers, raw JSONata argument/code capture and a correlated raw-message log at these newly typed sites: the latter would preserve sensitive exception content without adding actionable user-visible information beyond the safe cause. Preserve Mutate/Exit's existing author-text inconsistency explicitly in ADR0088 rather than silently enlarging scope. Decline provider/recovery redesign, automatic retry, historic rewrites and compensating side effects.

Implementation routing is the frozen i4-486-implementation-routing-01 plan, SHA256SUMS b00df574b3171926a0c953f8bab8fe53f63ea30f296207ccf4864b3f92972710. Escalate shared/core architecture and inference/child integration to GPT6.2Astra xhigh because26boundaries cross provenance and persistence safety. Offload bounded workspace, leaf-handler and public-child test tasks to GPT6.1Sol xhigh after the real shared interface is frozen. Exclusive file ownership, root-only index/commit/gates, no simultaneous shared-file writes; use at most root+core+two bounded workers. Actual Claude Opus xhigh opposite-family implementation review and independent QA remain mandatory; Fable planning is neither. Native filesystem, disk SQLite/restart, script counters, loopbackHTTP, publicREST/MCP/browser checks must distinguish real sinks from scripted providers. Existing numerical coverage, current-head/current-target CI, three-general-scan policy, reserved freshAstraMAX final audit and signed merge remain intact.

Implementation starts only after public plan/critique/selection readback and gate reconciliation. ADR0088 is reserved. This selects work; it claims no implementation, test, review, acceptance or completed intent.
